advancedBanner.title: Looking for more options?
advancedBanner.description: Advanced mode includes custom schedules, rule files, compression, retention, and file size limits.

schedule.title: Backup schedule
schedule.description: Schedule automatic backups of your files.

retention.title: Backup retention
retention.description: Configure how long to keep backups.

latest.label: Latest backups
latest.description: The number of latest backups to keep.

hourly.label: Hourly backups
hourly.description: The number of hourly backups to keep.

daily.label: Daily backups
daily.description: The number of daily backups to keep.

weekly.label: Weekly backups
weekly.description: The number of weekly backups to keep.

monthly.label: Monthly backups
monthly.description: The number of monthly backups to keep.

annual.label: Annual backups
annual.description: The number of annual backups to keep.

info.title: How backup retention works
info.description: BlinkDisk keeps the number of latest backups you set for each time period. A backup is kept if it matches any rule, others are removed to save space.

files.title: Excluded files
files.description: Exclude files and directories from backups.

exclusions.label: Excluded files and directories
exclusions.description: Files, directories and extensions to exclude from backups.
exclusions.descriptionWithRoot: Files, folders and extensions to exclude from this folder's backups.

broken.description: Rules entered as full paths never match anything. Rules must be relative to the backed-up folder.
broken.descriptionOutside: Paths outside {{root}} can't be excluded from this folder's backups. Edit or remove these rules.
broken.descriptionWithoutRoot: Rules entered as full paths never match anything. To exclude a specific folder, add the rule to that folder's own policy.

path.label: Folder or file
path.descriptionWithoutRoot: Relative to each backed-up folder, e.g. /AppData/Local/Temp.

errors.INVALID: This path can't be used. Paths with ".." or drive-relative paths like C:folder aren't supported.
errors.IS_ROOT: This is the backed-up folder itself. Choose something inside it.
errors.NEEDS_ROOT: Full paths only work on a folder's own policy. Enter a path relative to the backed-up folder instead.

pattern.label: where name
pattern.description: Matches files and folders with this name anywhere in the backup.

errors.path: Names can't contain \ or drive letters.

pathHint.withRoot: This looks like a path. To exclude one specific folder or file, use a path rule instead.
pathHint.withoutRoot: This looks like a path. To exclude one specific folder or file, add the rule to that folder's own policy.

extension.label: where file extension is
extension.placeholder: Enter file extension (e.g., pdf, jpg or docx)

broken.fullPath: Not working: entered as a full path
broken.outside: Not working: path is outside this folder
broken.isRoot: Not working: points to the backed-up folder itself
broken.invalid: Not working: edit this rule to fix it

maxFileSize.label: Maximum file size
maxFileSize.description: Maximum file size to include in backups.

excludeCacheDirs.label: Exclude cache directories
excludeCacheDirs.description: Exclude common cache directories in backups.

compression.title: Compression
compression.description: Configure how backup data is compressed.

algorithm.label: Compression algorithm
algorithm.description: The algorithm used to compress backup data.

minFileSize.label: Minimum file size
minFileSize.description: Only compress files larger than this size.

maxFileSize.label: Maximum file size
maxFileSize.description: Only compress files smaller than this size.

extensionAllowlist.label: Extension allowlist
extensionAllowlist.description: Only compress files with these extensions.

extensionDenylist.label: Extension denylist
extensionDenylist.description: Never compress files with these extensions.
